name: Jellybean Games
bio: Jellybean Games was founded in 2015 by designer Peter C. Hayward to make short, light games the whole family can play, from the pirate card game Scuttle! and Village Pillage to the Dracula's Feast deduction series. Most of its catalogue is offered as a free print-and-play on its website; the files carry a plain copyright notice and are for personal use, so this site links to them rather than hosting copies.
